  - PLAN

  dataset: EX

  - EX.EXSTDTC

  type: str
  label: Subject
  derivation: PC.USUBJID
- name: PCSEQ
  type: int
  label: Sequence
  derivation: PC.PCSEQ
- name: ADTM
  type: datetime
  label: Sample
  derivation: PC.PCDTC
- name: FANLDTM
  type: datetime
  label: First dose
  derivation: FIRSTDOSE.EXSTDTC
- name: PLTS
  type: int
  label: Planned seconds
  derivation:
    duration_value:
      source: PC.PCELTM
      unit: second
- name: WINDOW
  type: datetime
  label: Window end
  derivation:
    datetime_shift:
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: 4
      unit: hour
- name: AFRLT
  type: float
  label: Relative hours
  derivation:
    datetime_diff:
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: hour

  type: int
  label: Relative seconds
  derivation:
    datetime_diff:
      start: FANLDTM
      end: ADTM
      unit: second

  type: datetime
  label: Planned sample
  derivation:
    datetime_shift:
      source: FANLDTM
      amount: PLTS
      unit: second
- name: CANON
  type: str
  label: Planned elapsed text
  derivation:
    duration_text:
      source: PLTS
      unit: second
- name: INWIN
  type: str
  label: Within four hours
  derivation:
    flag:
      condition: ADTM >= FANLDTM and ADTM <= WINDOW
      false_value: N
      missing: null

schema_version: '1.0'
domain: ADLBC
input:
  LB:
    path: input/lb.csv
    types:
      STUDYID: str
      USUBJID: str
      LBTESTCD: str
      LBSEQ: int
      VISITNUM: int
      LBSTRESN: float
keys:
- K
output:
  path: out.csv
  columns:
  - K
  - STUDYID
  - USUBJID
  - LBTESTCD
  - LBSEQ
  - AVAL
columns:
- name: K
  type: int
- name: STUDYID
  type: str
- name: USUBJID
  type: str
- name: LBTESTCD
  type: str
- name: LBSEQ
  type: int
- name: AVAL
  type: float
intermediates:
- id: EOTFB
  dataset: LB
  derivations:
    _EOT_AWARE:
      case:
      - when: LB.VISITNUM = 9
        then:
          literal: 99
      - otherwise:
          source: LB.VISITNUM
    _RN:
      row_number:
        window:
          group_by:
          - STUDYID
          - USUBJID
          - LBTESTCD
          order_by:
          - variable: _EOT_AWARE
            direction: desc
          - variable: LBSEQ
  filter: LB._RN = 1 AND LB._EOT_AWARE <> 99
  columns:
  - STUDYID
  - USUBJID
  - LBTESTCD
  - LBSEQ
  - VISITNUM
  - LBSTRESN
rows:
- id: eot2
  dataset: EOTFB
  filter: EOTFB.VISITNUM <> 12
  derivations:
    K:
      source: EOTFB.LBSEQ
    STUDYID:
      source: EOTFB.STUDYID
    USUBJID:
      source: EOTFB.USUBJID
    LBTESTCD:
      source: EOTFB.LBTESTCD
    LBSEQ:
      source: EOTFB.LBSEQ
    AVAL:
      source: EOTFB.LBSTRESN
